info.title: NTL BullshitBench v2 paragraphs
info.description: 40-250-word plain-prose paragraphs extracted from BullshitBench v2 model responses (https://github.com/petergpt/bullshit-benchmark, MIT License; see the repository for copyright), restricted to the 16 models that overlap with the Name That LLM label set. Columns: model, text, doc (source response id), variant (reasoning setting).
